literal_meaning: বাজির মাত (বাজি জেতা বা খেলায় পরাজিত করা)
figurative_meaning_bn: খেলায় বা প্রতিযোগিতায় জয়; জয়-পরাজয়ের নিস্পত্তি
figurative_meaning_en: Victory in a game or competition; settling of win or loss
example_sentences_in_english: They clinched the victory in the football match.
He came out on top in the debate.
note: Originates from traditional betting and gaming contexts in Bengali culture.
